I'll rank line 34 as plausible (propagation), line 30, and note recursion depth at line 36. Actually one genuine bug: when a subtree contains a node whose insurance covers ancestors? No, insurance covers descendants only.

Hmm, another: defaultdict(-1) accessed for each node inside dfs — fine.
